t.zh: 一个介词短语前面有好几个名词时，它不一定挂在最近的那个上。
t.en: With several nouns before a prepositional phrase, it does not always hang on the nearest.

title.zh: We report the speedup of our implementation over the reference code.
title.en: We report the speedup of our implementation over the reference code.

body.zh: 两个介词短语都挂在 speedup 上：谁的加速（of our implementation），相对谁（over the reference code）。我们报告自己的实现相对参考代码的加速比。
body.en: Both phrases hang on speedup: whose (of our implementation) and over what (over the reference code). We report how much faster our implementation is than the reference code.

note.zh: 有的名词自己带着固定的介词（speedup over、improvement on）。
note.en: Some nouns come with their own preposition (speedup over, improvement on).

brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来，挂到它修饰的词上。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton and fold each modifier onto the word it modifies.

hint.zh: over：比谁快？什么东西“比参考代码”？
hint.en: over: faster than what? What is it that is “over the reference code”?

tasks.sentence: We report the speedup of our implementation over the reference code.

implementation.zh: “比参考代码更……的实现”说不通。over 跟着 speedup：比参考代码快了多少。
implementation.en: “Our implementation over the reference code” makes no sense. over goes with speedup: how much faster than the reference code.

report.zh: “越过参考代码去报告”说不通。over 说的是加速比相对于谁。
report.en: “Reporting over the reference code” makes no sense. over says what the speedup is measured against.
